abilities.effect: The triggering creature falls through the illusory floor and takes falling damage (typically 20 bludgeoning damage). That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling. The DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 20.
abilities.name: Drop
abilities.trigger: A creature walks onto the illusory floor

hazard.description: The floor in this chamber is an illusion, which conceals a 40-foot drop to the true floor below. Additionally, the area beneath the floor is magically silenced—no sound is audible within nor does sound leave this space.
hazard.disable: Succeeding on a Perception check against the Stealth DC of 21 (including the check to find the trap) disbelieves the illusory floor, or *dispel magic* (2nd level; counteract DC 18) to dispel the illusory floor; *dispel magic* (2nd level; counteract DC 20) to dispel the magical silence
hazard.name: False Floor

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: or 0 if the illusory floor is dispelled

traits.name: Illusion
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait involve false sensory stimuli.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
